The coldest conditions were noted during the morning of the 22nd. Temperatures dropped as low as -18F, with reported wind chill values as low as -22F on an isolated basis.
Three to five inches fell across the area, highest a bit north of New Florence and the county line.
A total of 6.8 inches was reported at Armagh, and 6 inches fell at Brush Valley.
A total of 5.5 inches fell at Brush Valley and Armagh.

costliest.narrative: The call center reported that numerous power lines were blown down across the county during the day.  Specific examples were noted on Mack Drive near Wehrum and Black Lick Road near Armagh.
Reports of downed trees and wires were received from Dias and Germany. In Waterman, a tree fell on a car on Route 56.  A few people were trapped in the car, but no injuries were reported.
